kind: Retained native candidate failure and test-driver corrections, not publication proof
failure: After its deliberate gunshot, the stationary survivor spent additional time in inventory and presentation menus, attracted a real lookout and died. The driver's later request for a play-only Pause row correctly found the death interface instead. There were no captured JavaScript or console errors.
correction: Complete quiet presentation, inventory and confirmation checks before deliberate firing; then select the actual sidearm, verify finite firing and reload, and use the native Exit XR control. Keep every gameplay/resource/pose assertion and all living enemies. Do not grant health, freeze the clock or weaken patrols.
startup_contract_review: A new expedition automatically creates a real initial shelter checkpoint. The new journey now checks for no planted save before selecting Start, then verifies that the genuine new-game checkpoint contains no acquired items or completed tasks. It does not falsely require the save to remain absent after Start.
runtime_changes: None in this test-order correction. The preceding final candidate's raised sorting screen and old-drop guard remain unchanged.
evidence_boundary: A menu/input regression is not an encounter-survival policy. The separate normal-start Freight Cut journey must still recover both objects, use the passage, manage actual resources, extract and restore its earned save.
